annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología, Conocimiento e Innovación (MinCiencia), Chile
key_provisions_or_claims: Plataforma Algoritmos Públicos (GobLab UAI, funded by ANID) nominated to represent Chile in the first UNESCO-Uzbekistan Beruniy Prize on AI ethics.
Platform provides tools to evaluate, monitor and document automated decision systems in public services; 13 pilots in 9 services.
Chile's AI usage bill is under discussion in Congress.
Prize awards $30,000 to three winners biennially; ceremony in Samarkand in November.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Chilean Science Ministry news item announcing that the Algoritmos Públicos platform (GobLab UAI) will represent Chile in the first UNESCO-Uzbekistan Beruniy Prize on AI ethics. The platform audits algorithms used in public services; the piece also mentions Chile's pending AI bill.
annotation.title_clean: MinCiencia elige a plataforma "Algoritmos Públicos" para representar a Chile en Premio de Unesco a la Ética en IA
annotation.title_en: MinCiencia selects "Algoritmos Públicos" platform to represent Chile in UNESCO Prize for AI Ethics
